usageNotes: Use this to discard pending (uncommitted) network changes on a PDM node — it deletes `/etc/network/interfaces.new`, leaving the live `/etc/network/interfaces` untouched. Call this after a failed or unwanted `PUT /nodes/{node}/network` before applying changes, not after. Requires `System.Modify` on the node and returns null synchronously (no UPID).

examples.summary: Revert staged network changes on node 'pdm-node1'

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the staged network configuration file (`/etc/network/interfaces.new`), discarding any unsaved interface edits without recovery.
tips: This only removes the staged config — the live running network config is unaffected.
If `interfaces.new` does not exist the call still returns null without error.
Run before `POST /nodes/{node}/network` (apply) if you want to abort pending changes rather than commit them.
